description: Deterministic rounding rules for customs duty calculations

summary.principle: All monetary amounts round UP to nearest 100 KHR (ceiling function)
summary.exceptions: Quantities, rates, and exchange rates are NOT rounded - use exact values
summary.critical_rule: NEVER round DOWN - always use CEILING function

rounding_rules.name: Exchange Rate Precision
rounding_rules.rule: DO NOT round - use exactly as published
rounding_rules.description: Exchange rates published by MEF must be used exactly as-is

rounding_rules.name: Currency Conversion Result
rounding_rules.applies_when: Converting USD or other foreign currency to KHR
rounding_rules.notes: This is the ONLY standard rounding - rounds to nearest, not up

rounding_rules.name: Cambodia Customs Tax Components (COP, SOP, VOP)
rounding_rules.when_to_apply: After each component calculation, before using in next formula

cambodia_formulas.cop: COP = Customs Value × Import Tax Rate
cambodia_formulas.sop: SOP = (Customs Value + COP) × Special Tariff Rate
cambodia_formulas.vop_taxable: VOP = (Customs Value + COP + SOP) × 10% (for general taxable goods)

critical_notes: Apply this rule after EVERY tax component calculation
COP and SOP must be rounded individually before being added to next formula
VOP base changes depending on whether goods are taxable or non-taxable
For non-taxable goods: SOP = 0, so VOP = (CIF + COP) * 10%
For taxable goods: VOP = (CIF + COP + SOP) * 10%

rounding_rules.name: Final Payment Amount
rounding_rules.applies_when: When ready to display or collect payment

examples.note: Even 1 satoshi rounds up entire hundred

rounding_rules.notes: This is final amount on payment receipt (SAD Box B). ALWAYS round UP.

rounding_rules.name: Quantity Values
rounding_rules.rule: NO ROUNDING - use exact declared values
rounding_rules.applies_when: All quantity fields from customs declaration
rounding_rules.formula: Use value as-is; do not round

examples.note: Precision from customs document is important

critical_notes: Quantities used in tax calculation (e.g., excise per liter)
NEVER round quantities up or down

rounding_rules.name: Tax Rates and Duty Rates
rounding_rules.rule: NO ROUNDING - use exactly as published in tariff schedule
rounding_rules.applies_when: All rate lookups from tariff tables
critical_notes: Rates come from authoritative tariff schedule
Using rounded rates creates cascading errors

step_1.name: Currency Conversion
step_1.operation: Customs Value (USD) × Exchange Rate = Customs Value (KHR)

step_2.name: Calculate COP (Customs of Payment / Import Duty)
step_2.formula_name: COP = Customs Value × Import Tax Rate

step_3.name: Calculate SOP (Special Tariff / Special Tax)
step_3.formula_name: SOP = (Customs Value + COP) × Special Tariff Rate
step_3.applies_when: Product is subject to special tax or excise (identified by HS code)

step_4.name: Determine VOP Base (VAT Tax Base)
step_4.description: Check if product is taxable or non-taxable

goods_categories.non_taxable: Medical equipment, certain QIP goods, exempted items (SOP rate = 0%)
goods_categories.general_taxable: Most goods with SOP rate > 0% (alcohol, tobacco, vehicles, luxury goods)

step_8.name: Final Total Payable
step_8.note: This is the final amount shown on payment receipt (SAD Box B)

detailed_examples.scenario: Simple calculation with all rounding steps (Taxable Goods)

steps.formula: COP = Customs Value × Import Tax Rate
SOP = (Customs Value + COP) × Special Tariff Rate
VOP = (CIF + COP) × 10% (for non-taxable goods, SOP excluded)

steps.note: Lower tax liability for non-taxable goods due to VOP calculation

detailed_examples.scenario: Calculation with fractional cents requiring rounding up

common_mistakes_to_avoid.mistake: Applying SOP to customs value alone
common_mistakes_to_avoid.wrong: SOP = Customs Value × Special Tariff Rate
common_mistakes_to_avoid.correct: SOP = (Customs Value + COP) × Special Tariff Rate

common_mistakes_to_avoid.mistake: Using wrong VOP base for non-taxable goods
common_mistakes_to_avoid.impact: Over-calculation of VAT for medical/exempt goods

common_mistakes_to_avoid.mistake: Rounding intermediate amounts then rounding again
common_mistakes_to_avoid.wrong: Round COP to 100, then round (CIF+COP) to 100 before calculating SOP
common_mistakes_to_avoid.correct: Round COP to 100 using that value, then calculate SOP with rounded COP

common_mistakes_to_avoid.mistake: Forgetting VAT is applied to sum (not CIF alone)

common_mistakes_to_avoid.wrong: Quantity 100.5 units → round to 100; Duty rate 35% → round to 40%
common_mistakes_to_avoid.impact: Wrong tax basis and non-reproducible calculations

tool_implementation_checklist: ✓ Load exchange rates exactly as published (no rounding)
✓ Round currency conversion result to whole number (ROUND, Rule 002)
✓ Calculate COP = Customs Value × Import Tax Rate ; Round to nearest 100 (CEILING, Rule 003)
✓ Calculate SOP = (Customs Value + COP) × Special Tariff Rate ; Round to nearest 100 (Rule 003)
✓ Determine VOP base: If SOP=0 (non-taxable): base=(CIF+COP) ; If SOP>0 (taxable): base=(CIF+COP+SOP)
✓ Calculate VOP = VOP_base × 10% ; Round to nearest 100 (Rule 003)
✓ Do not round tax rates or quantities - use exact values
✓ Sum all rounded components: Total = COP + SOP + VOP
✓ Final payment amount must also be rounded to nearest 100 (CEILING, Rule 004)
✓ Log each rounding step for audit trail
✓ Display final amount rounded to nearest 100 on receipt (SAD Box B)
